# Subscribe for News Alerts


If you are an analyst or reporter and would like to receive news alerts from Arm, please complete the information below.


**Subscription is limited to analysts and reporters.** If you are not an analyst or reporter and want to keep up to date with the latest developments from Arm:


- Sign up to receive our[newsletter](https://engaged.arm.com/Preferences-center.html) ; or
- Subscribe to Blog and Podcast updates on the[Blogs page](https://newsroom.arm.com/blog) .
